WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE date < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ) SELECT (WEEKDAY(d.date) + 1) AS day_of_week, MAX(CASE WHEN d.week_type = 'last' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS lNum, MAX(CASE WHEN d.week_type = 'current' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS tNum FROM ( SELECT dr.date, CASE WHEN dr.date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL -1 DAY) THEN 'last' ELSE 'current' END AS week_type, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) -- 关键修正：去重统计 FROM tbl_user_club WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time <= CONCAT(dr.date, ' 23:59:59') ) AS cnt FROM date_range dr ) d GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week;
